claim: The exam is offered in English, French (France), Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish (Latin America), Spanish (Spain), Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese; for an online proctored exam at Pearson VUE, a candidate who signed up for a localized exam can also view questions in English during the exam by using the toggle feature.

qualifiers.scope: per exam; the English toggle is stated for online proctored exams at Pearson VUE

note: The toggle sentence stands under 'Scheduling Exams > Online proctored exams > Exams at Pearson VUE' on the before-testing page, so the claim scopes it to online proctored exams. Repaired 2026-10-11 after a partial entail vote.
